env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

[cgo] ! logos build -o $WORK/logos$GOEXE ./sub
[cgo] stderr 'restriction::cgo_usage'
[cgo] go build -o $WORK/plain$GOEXE ./sub
[cgo] exec $WORK/plain$GOEXE
[cgo] stdout '^42$'
[cgo] go build -a -x -o $WORK/plainx$GOEXE ./sub
[cgo] ! stderr 'inlbudget'
[cgo] ! stderr 'variablemakethreshold'
[cgo] stderr 'GOAMD64='
[cgo] ! stderr 'GOAMD64=v[234]'
[cgo] ! stderr 'GOEXPERIMENT=[^ ]*logosarena'
